findings.F1: The book loses because its forecast does not carry the graded effect that is in the data. The raw situation (weekend move in usual 48-hour moves × weekday/weekend volume ratio) predicts the next 48 hours with slope -0.038, t -2.78, on 2286 weekly cases. The traded forecast, standardised and negated, has a slope of -0.0003, t -0.18, despite a correlation of 0.85 with that raw product.

findings.F5: Among the thinnest weekends, the reversal is by far strongest after a 30-day rise: slope -0.466, t -4.10, 197 cases. After a 30-day fall it is -0.117 (t -1.19), and in a flat month -0.113 (t -1.12).
findings.F6: Most of the losses fall on the two days the bet is held. Mean position is 0.50 on Monday and 0.48 on Tuesday, against about 0.02 on other days. The book's gain per bar is -0.04 bp on Monday and -0.14 bp on Tuesday.

ideas.idea: The lower a coin's weekend volume is compared with its volume over the preceding five weekdays, the larger the share of its Saturday-Sunday move that is reversed over Monday and Tuesday. This holds only for weekend moves that are large in the coin's usual 48-hour moves, and the reversal grows with the product of the move's size and the weekend's thinness.
ideas.consequence: A trader would bet against only the largest thin-volume weekend moves on Sunday's close, sized by move times thinness, and refuse the small ones that tend to continue.
ideas.name: large thin weekend moves reverse

ideas.idea: The lower a coin's weekend volume is compared with its volume over the preceding five weekdays, the larger the share of its Saturday-Sunday move that is reversed over Monday and Tuesday, the more so the higher the coin's hourly volatility over the preceding 30 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would lean harder against thin weekend moves in a coin that has been volatile for a month, and stand aside in a calm one where weekend moves carry on.
ideas.name: thin weekends reverse when volatile

ideas.idea: The lower a coin's weekend volume is compared with its volume over the preceding five weekdays, the larger the share of its Saturday-Sunday move that is reversed over Monday and Tuesday, the more so the more the coin has risen over the preceding 30 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would bet hardest against thin weekend moves in a coin that has rallied for a month.
ideas.name: thin weekend reversal after rally
